newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-RONALDO SET FOR INTERNAZIONALE DEBUT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RONALDO SET FOR INTERNAZIONALE DEBUT.

text.p: Brazil striker Ronaldo is set to make his debut for Internazionale Milan at the weekend, before disagreements over his transfer from Barcelona are resolved.

Inter said on Thursday that world footballer of the year Ronaldo would make his first appearance for the Italian club in a friendly against English premier league champions Manchester United on Sunday.
The 20-year-old striker is expected to arrive in Milan on Friday from Brazil.
Inter president Massimo Moratti said he would travel to Zurich next week to meet Barcelona chiefs ahead of the July 31 deadline set by FIFA for the two clubs to reach an accord over Ronaldo.
"We will meet Barcelona in Zurich, neutral ground, on Tuesday July 29," Moratti said.
World soccer governing body FIFA cleared the way for Ronaldo to join Inter when it said earlier this week the player was free of any contractual obligations with Barcelona.

FIFA general secretary Sepp Blatter said Ronaldo had legitimately bought out his employment contract with the Spanish club for four billion pesetas ($26.3 million) but added this was not related to any additional transfer fee.
If there is no agreement on such a fee between the two clubs by July 31 then FIFA will act as arbitrator and impose a binding fee.
